transcript_segments.text: funny thing everybody wants to be original which is brave
considering most of us learned language from people who were already talking
yeah i've been stealing fire with receipts
i used to want my name carved deep in the door
big letters saying i was here before
not huge not greedy just you know tastefully immortal
a plaque would do
maybe brass maybe somewhere near the snacks
because i worked on the thing till the thing worked back
till my eyes went dry and my shoulders attacked
mm yeah
till the song had teeth and the lion had feet
till the tiny little engine could cross the street
and then someone says nice then moves on
three weeks of my life became six seconds
and a thumb and a smile like thank you
while inside a small accountant set fire to a chair
but i didn't build this from nothing at all
i borrowed the ladder i borrowed the wall
i'm standing on shoulders and lending my bones
making a step out of all i own
maybe they won't know what it cost me to climb
but if they see further then the work did fine
but still accept applause i'm evolving and not dead
every song has ancestors humming in the floor
every painting has fingerprints under the door
every sentence i wrote has a village behind it
some teach it with patience some poet with timing
some stranger online who explains something twice
while being called an idiot by a man named ice mantis
beautiful species terrible common sections
i've taken little pieces from a thousand kind hands
a rhythm from a busker a wound from a friend
a phrase from my father a joke from regret
a chord from a song i pretended to forget
and none of it means the making was hollow
it means i was fed before i learned how to swallow
means i found a path because others wore ground
means the map had names even when i looked down
so yes put me in the footnotes
small print back page near the typo i'll wave
i'm standing on shoulders and lending my bones
making a step out of all i own
maybe they won't know what it cost me to climb
but if they see further then the work did fine
and i won't pretend it doesn't sting of course it stings
i'm not a monk i'm a tired little creature
with the password manager and the approval issues
i want someone to notice the hours the ugly drafts
the line i cut that deserved a small funeral
the chorus i rebuilt so many times
it started asking for union rights
i want them to know i care
that i didn't just toss it into the world like loose change
i carried it badly sometimes with snacks but i carry it
and still maybe love is letting the thing go
without stapling your whole face to the front of it
maybe art is not always a monument sometimes
it's a bridge that thanks you by being crossed
i like the idea of the open door the shared shelf
but take this make more a recipe passed on with sauce on the page
a little note saying careful here this bit breaks
that feels honest that feels clean
not mine forever just mine in between
like i found a cracked cup and filled it with rain
and left it by the path for whoever came
and maybe some kid with a second hand might
takes one little line and makes something bright
maybe they never know my name or my doubt
or maybe they build a house where i only marked out
one nail one bank one awkward suggestion
one body lit answer to a private question
and maybe that's enough
god i hate how mature that sounds
tragic growth is terrible branding
let the work travel let the name travel less
let the heart leave a handle for whoever comes next
i'm standing on shoulders lending my bones
making a step out of all i own
maybe they won't know what it cost me to climb
but if they see further then the work did fine
i'm not the first fire i'm not the last flame
i'm one little match in a long human chain
if i am forgotten but the song still gets through
then i was a doorway
and someone walked through
so no i didn't make this from nothing nobody does
i made it from everything that made me
from hands i never thanked from names i mispronounced
from borrowed courage and returned mistakes
and maybe someday someone will step on this
not cruelly just naturally
on their way to somewhere better
and i hope it holds i hope it helps
i hope they don't look down too long
i hope they keep going
because maybe the point was never
look at me
maybe the point was here stand here
you can see a little further
